'''Samardo Anthony Samuels''' (born January 9, 1989) is a Jamaican professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Trotamundos de Carabobo]]. He is an NBA Veteran, Italian League Champion and Greek League All-Star. With a global career spanning over 15 years as a professional basketball player, he has played in over 13 countries across the world and represented Jamaica in the FIBA Americas Championship. ==High school career== Samuels attended [[Our Savior New American School]] in [[Centereach, New York]] as a freshman, then attended [[Saint Benedict's Preparatory School]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] for the rest of high school.{{cite web | url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/features/growingup_samuels_110204.html | title=Growing up ... Samardo Samuels | website=[[NBA.com]] }} Samuels was ranked 9th in the nation by [[Rivals.com]]{{Cite web |url=http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewrank.asp |title=Rivals.com Prospect Rankings |access-date=July 17, 2008 |archive-date=June 15, 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080615032930/http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewrank.asp |url-status=dead }} and 2nd in the nation by Scout.com.[http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&pid=88&yr=2008 Scout.com: Football Recruiting] He, alongside class of 2010 star [[Tristan Thompson]] led St. Benedicts's Prep to a 24–1 record in the 2007–2008 season. At season's end St. Benedict's was ranked #2 in the nation by ''[[USA Today]]''.{{cite news| url=https://www.usatoday.com/sports/preps/basketball/poll/2007-super25.htm | work=USA Today | title=Super 25: Lincoln (N.Y.) climbs three spots with state title | first=Jim | last=Halley | date=2008-05-02 | accessdate=2010-05-23}} He played in the two top all-American games, the [[McDonald's All-American Game]] and the [[Jordan Brand Classic]]. ==College career== Samuels decided to attend the [[University of Louisville]] for college. He chose the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Cardinals]] over [[Connecticut Huskies men's basketball|Connecticut]], [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[Georgetown Hoyas basketball|Georgetown]] and [[North Carolina Tar Heels basketball|North Carolina]]. At Louisville, Samuels started every game that he played in and led the [[2009-10 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|2009–10 team]] in scoring and rebounding. After his sophomore year, he decided to skip his final two years of college eligibility and enter the [[2010 NBA draft]]. ==Professional career== ===Cleveland Cavaliers (2010–13)=== After going undrafted in the [[2010 NBA draft]], Samuels played for the [[Chicago Bulls]] in the [[2010 NBA Summer League]],{{cite news|title=NBA Summer League Rosters - Vegas|url=http://www.ridiculousupside.com/2010/6/28/1540775/nba-summer-league-rosters-vegas|accessdate=July 22, 2015|work=Ridiculousupside.com|date=June 28, 2010}} averaging 12.6 points and 7.4 rebounds. On August 17, 2010, Samuels signed a 3-year, $2.3 million contract with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]]. A portion of the deal was guaranteed.[http://www.courier-journal.com/article/20100816/SPORTS02/308160109/ Ex-Louisville forward Samardo Samuels signs with Cavaliers] He debuted against the [[Toronto Raptors]], on October 29, and scored 7 points. On December 27, 2010, he was sent to the [[Erie BayHawks (2008–2017)|Erie BayHawks]], the Cavs' affiliate in the [[NBA G League|NBA Development League]].{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels Assigned to Erie BayHawks|url=http://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/samuels_101227.html|accessdate=July 22, 2015|work=NBA.com|date=December 27, 2010}} On January 1, after two games in the [[NBA G League|NBA D-League]], he was recalled by the Cavs. On March 2, 2011, Samuels made his first career start against the [[San Antonio Spurs]] in place of the injured [[Antawn Jamison]] and scored a career high 23 points while pulling down 10 rebounds.[https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4304/samardo-samuels Samardo Samuels Game-by-Game Stats] On December 28, 2012, Samuels was assigned to the [[Canton Charge]] of the D-League.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/cleveland_cavaliers_assign_sam_2012_12_28.html Cleveland Cavaliers Assign Samardo Samuels to NBA D-League Affiliate Canton Charge] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121231153202/http://www.nba.com/dleague/cleveland_cavaliers_assign_sam_2012_12_28.html |date=2012-12-31 }} He was recalled on December 31, 2012.[http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=11883 Cavs recall Samardo Samuels from D-League] On January 6, 2013, he was waived by the Cavaliers.[http://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/samuels-waived-130106 Cavaliers Waive Samuels] ===Several short stints (2013)=== Following the waiving by the Cavaliers, he was acquired by the D-League's [[Reno Bighorns]] on January 17, 2013.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/dleague/transactions.html 2012–13 Transactions] On April 7, 2013, Samuels signed with the Israeli club [[Hapoel Jerusalem B.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]] for the rest of the 2012–13 season.{{cite web|title=Hapoel Jerusalem officially signs Samardo Samuels to a 2-month deal|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/israel/53748/hapoel-jerusalem-officially-signs-samardo-samuels-to-a-2-month-deal.html|publisher=Sportando.net|accessdate=25 July 2013}} ===Olimpia Milano (2013–15)=== On July 25, 2013, he signed a two-year deal with the Italian club [[Pallacanestro Olimpia Milano|Emporio Armani Milano]].{{cite web|title=Olimpia Milano officially sign Samardo Samuels|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/italy/serie-a/60197/olimpia-milano-officially-sign-samardo-samuels.html|publisher=Sportando.net|accessdate=25 July 2013}} In his first [[2013–14 Euroleague|Euroleague]] season with Milano, he averaged 9.5 points and 3.9 rebounds over 25 games. In his second season with Milano, he elevated his game and averaged 12.9 points and 5.4 rebounds over 23 [[2014–15 Euroleague|Euroleague]] games. In the summer of 2015, he parted ways with Olimpia Milano.{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels won't come back to Milano|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/italy/serie-a/167374/samardo-samuels-won-t-come-back-to-milano.html|accessdate=15 March 2018|work=sportando.basketball|date=6 July 2015}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} ===Barcelona (2015–16)=== On July 22, 2015, Samuels signed a two-year deal with the Spanish club [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona Lassa]].{{cite news|title=FC Barcelona lands big man Samuels|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/67uo6nxaykqmbugj|accessdate=July 22, 2015|work=Euroleague.net|date=July 22, 2015}} On September 11, 2015, Barcelona announced that Samuels has suffered right hand injury and will miss about 6 weeks of action.{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels out 6 weeks for a fracture of the metatarsus|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/175589/samardo-samuels-out-6-weeks-for-a-fracture-of-the-metatarsus.html|accessdate=11 September 2015|work=sportando.com|date=11 September 2015}} In his third consecutive Euroleague season, his role in the new team decreased, and he had averages of 6 points and 2.8 rebounds over 26 games. On August 16, 2016, he parted ways with Barcelona.[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/209587/samardo-samuels-barcelona-lassa-part-ways.html Samardo Samuels, Barcelona Lassa part ways] ===Jiangsu Dragons (2016–17)=== On August 17, 2016, Samuels signed with the [[Chinese Basketball Association]] club [[Jiangsu Dragons]] for the [[2016–17 CBA season]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/209700/samardo-samuels-officially-signs-with-jiangsu-dragons.html Samardo Samuels officially signs with Jiangsu Dragons] ===Several short stints (2017–present)=== On March 17, 2017, he signed with the Italian club [[New Basket Brindisi|Enel Brindisi]] for the rest of the [[2016–17 Lega Basket Serie A|2016–17 LBA season]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/229210/samardo-samuels-official-signs-with-new-basket-brindisi.html Samardo Samuels official signs with New Basket Brindisi] On August 18, 2017, Samuels signed with the Spanish club [[CB Sevilla|Real Betis Energía Plus]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/244548/samardo-samuels-signs-with-real-betis-energia-plus.html Samardo Samuels signs with Real Betis Energia Plus] On September 21, 2017, he parted ways with Real Betis Energía Plus before appearing in a game for them.{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels, Real Betis Energia Plus officially part ways|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/spain/acb/247572/samardo-samuels-real-betis-energia-plus-officially-part-ways.html|accessdate=21 September 2017|work=Sportando|date=21 September 2017}} On October 16, 2017, Samuels signed with the Serbian club [[KK Partizan|Partizan]] for the rest of the 2017–18 season.{{cite news|title=Samardo Semjuels je novi igrač Partizana|url=http://kkpartizan.rs/sr/vest/2142/samardo-semjuels-je-novi-igrac-partizanawork=partizan.rs|accessdate=October 16, 2017|work=kkpartizan.rs|date=October 16, 2017|language=Serbian}} He was suspended by the club on November 15, for the violation of club's discipline and the provisions of the contract, day after Partizan lost in a [[2017–18 EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] game against [[Alba Berlin]].{{cite news|title=Semjuels u "svađi" sa formom, Nikolićem, grobarima|url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2017&mm=11&dd=15&nav_id=1325568|accessdate=16 November 2017|work=b92.net|agency=Tanjug|date=15 November 2017|language=Serbian}}{{cite news|title=Partizan suspendovao Semjuelsa|url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2017&mm=11&dd=15&nav_id=1325896|accessdate=16 November 2017|work=b92.net|date=15 November 2017|language=Serbian}} The suspension came as a result of his public criticism of the club, head coach [[Miroslav Nikolić]] and other inappropriate remarks toward female journalists. Shortly after, he parted ways with the club.{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels, KK Partizan parting ways|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/europe/serbia/254442/samardo-samuels-kk-partizan-parting-ways.html|accessdate=15 March 2018|work=sportando.basketball|date=18 November 2017}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} On February 14, 2018, Samuels signed with the French club [[Limoges CSP]] for the rest of the 2017–18 season.{{cite news|title=Samardo Samuels au Limoges CSP !|url=https://www.limogescsp.com/news/20180214055919-samardo-samuels-au-limoges-csp|work=limogescsp.com|accessdate=February 14, 2018|date=February 14, 2018|language=French}} After averaging 11 points and 4 rebounds per game, he re-signed with the club on August 20, 2018.{{cite web |title=Limoges CSP re-signs Samardo Samuels |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/france/pro-a/286062/limoges-csp-re-signs-samardo-samuels.html |website=Sportando |accessdate=August 20, 2018 }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} In October 2018, Samuels was suspended after speaking harshly towards his coach and during a match which resulted him in being sidelined for the rest of the game.{{cite web |title=Limoges suspended Samardo Samuels - Eurohoops |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/747472/limoges-suspended-samardo-samuels/ |website=www.eurohoops.net |access-date=11 March 2025}} On February 16, 2020, Samuels signed with [[Chorale Roanne Basket]].{{cite news |title=Chorale Roanne ink Samardo Samuels |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/chorale-roanne-ink-samardo-samuels/ |website=Sportando |accessdate=February 16, 2020 |date=February 16, 2020|last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} In December 2020, Samuels signed with [[Maccabi Hod HaSharon]].{{cite news |title=Former NBA center Samardo Samuels agrees to deal with Maccabi Hod Hasharon |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/former-nba-center-samardo-samuels-agrees-to-deal-with-maccabi-hod-hasharon/?dev |website=Sportando |date=11 December 2020 |access-date=10 August 2021|last1=Borghesan |first1=Ennio Terrasi }} He played 17 games in the [[Liga Leumit (basketball)|Liga Leumit]], the second national tier, and averaged 16.2 points and 7.8 rebounds. On April 18, 2021, he has signed with [[Hapoel Haifa B.C.|Hapoel Haifa]] of the [[Israel Basketball Premier League]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/samardo-samuels-joins-hapoel-haifa/|title=Samardo Samuels joins Hapoel Haifa|last=|first=|date=April 18,
